search_contract.target: A new endpoint, host-audit, system-call, or provenance family whose official metadata exposes at least four source-native executions or captures.
required_metadata: Official artifact identity and immutable release or record revision
At least four curator-declared run, capture, execution, simulation, or independent-testbed units
A plausible physical boundary between raw evidence and labels, answers, or ground truth
No known reuse of an active train, development, or test artifact
search_contract.n_baiot_rule: N-BaIoT was not advanced or re-reviewed. It remains on hold unless artifact license, immutable checksum, source-native run lineage, and overlap with the approved IoT-23 test candidate are all closed first.

search_surfaces.purpose: Official description, license, revision, file size, and checksum verification
Repository discovery only; rate limiting prevented reliance on it for final evidence

reproducible_query_terms: endpoint security telemetry dataset attack runs
provenance graph intrusion dataset attack scenarios
host audit log cyber attack dataset experiments
system call intrusion dataset execution traces

source_identity.title: Dynamic Malware Analysis kernel and user-level calls
source_identity.creator: Matthew Nunes

official_run_declaration.source_native_mapping: The official description states that numbered folders represent the running of different samples and calls each such unit a run.
official_run_declaration.reason_independence_remains_unverified: The record identifies different sample runs but does not publish a reset/snapshot manifest or an immutable mapping that proves whether the kernel-driver and Cuckoo views correspond to the same runs.

fit_and_risks.raw_evidence_shape: per-run system-call logs and Cuckoo dynamic-analysis reports
fit_and_risks.label_isolation_candidate: Clean/VirusShare directory names and any Cuckoo detections must be excluded from model-visible paths and fields.
fit_and_risks.paired_view_rule: Kernel-driver and Cuckoo material from the same executed sample must remain one lineage group.
fit_and_risks.pointer_candidate: opaque archive id plus run directory plus source file and line or event index
future_required_checks: nested notice and archive manifest audit
sample-hash or run-id mapping across both archives
field-level exclusion of class paths, signatures, verdicts, and detector outputs
protected payload exact and near-duplicate scan

reviewable_directions.metadata_strength: The family is the clearest exact match for curator-declared independent testbeds, but it shares authors, institution, and a model-driven synthetic-testbed paradigm with the inactive CAM-LDS source.

candidate_releases.title: AIT Log Data Set V1.1
candidate_releases.official_group_declaration: Logs were collected from four independent testbeds; each testbed simulates a web-server/user-host environment for six days.
candidate_releases.duplicate_version_warning: AIT-LDS-v1_0.zip and AIT-LDS-v1_1.zip are versions of the same four-testbed collection and may not be counted as separate runs or families.

candidate_releases.title: AIT Log Data Set V2.1
candidate_releases.official_group_declaration: The record declares eight testbeds and eight named datasets, each with its own simulation and attack time; every dataset is published as a full archive and a no-PCAP derivative.
candidate_releases.derivative_warning: A full archive and its no-PCAP counterpart are two views of one testbed and provide only one lineage candidate.

overlap_assessment.shared_generation_nuisance: synthetic small-enterprise testbeds with overlapping host/audit/network log modalities
overlap_assessment.why_not_advance_now: The request is for a new distinct family. Metadata proves testbed groups but does not yet prove that AIT-LDS is sufficiently independent of the failed CAM-LDS/AInception research-program nuisance to fill the vacant slot.

screened_not_advanced.reason: The record exposes one SHA-named JSON report per CAPE execution trace and separate label-mapping files, but does not publish a reset/non-duplicate run manifest and declares no benign execution pool. Trace count is not promoted to independent-lineage credit.
The official record says each SHA-named JSON is a trace and provides a separate family map, but does not define each trace as a separately reset execution or publish a run manifest.

screened_not_advanced.official_reset_declaration: The Android operating system was re-initialized before every application run.
screened_not_advanced.reason: The lineage description is strong, but the current Zenodo record API exposes neither an artifact license nor file size/checksum metadata.
The record declares controlled executions and repeat runs but currently exposes no files, byte sizes, or checksums.
The record contains two attack scenarios. Four Samba datasets are individual phases or failed attempts inside one scenario, so their PCAP/host views cannot satisfy the independent-run requirement.

The record counts syscall sequences and bug-triggering programs across kernel releases, but does not publish source-native reset/run groups and is primarily a kernel-bug anomaly corpus rather than multi-entity security evidence.

The data records trainee progress and command histories for process mining. Participant and supervised-session counts do not establish independently captured endpoint evidence, and expected exercise definitions would be protected supervision.
The official record provides only a one-line description and exposes no files, runs, sizes, or checksums.

evidence: Zenodo 1203289 publishes two checksummed archives and explicitly maps numbered directories to runs of different clean or malicious samples.
AIT-LDS V1.1 explicitly says four independent testbeds; AIT-LDS V2.1 publishes eight named testbed archives and eight no-PCAP derivatives.
All other screened sources either lack reset/run declarations, lack artifact identity, or substitute phases, traces, participants, programs, or files for independent runs.
inference: Zenodo 1203289 is the most distinct new candidate direction, but a bounded review is still needed to bind paired sensor views and verify sandbox reset/non-duplication.
AIT-LDS has stronger curator-declared grouping but weaker portfolio distinctness because of CAM-LDS/AInception curator and testbed-generation overlap.
recommendation: Open a separate metadata candidate review for dynamic_malware_kernel_user_calls_2018 before any download.
Keep AIT-LDS on hold until a distinctness amendment decides whether same-curator/testbed nuisance is acceptable for the vacant slot.
Do not advance N-BaIoT, WinMET, DYNAMISM, SAPPAN, DongTing, or API-traces under this authorization.
